name: Yadokko Hotel Cards
author: raydallas

sections.description:
Yadokko Hotel Cards lets travel and hotel bloggers create a single, tidy card that links to several hotel booking services at once, and embed it in any post or page with a shortcode.

You register each hotel once as a custom post, then reuse it anywhere with [yadokko id="123"]. The card shows the hotel photo, name, address, review score and lowest price, followed by a row of booking buttons. Affiliate wrapping (ValueCommerce, A8.net, Rakuten Affiliate) is applied automatically from the IDs you enter in the settings; if you leave them blank the buttons link directly to each site.

Free version

  • Register and manage hotels as a custom post type
  • Search Rakuten Travel by hotel name and import the photo, address, review score and lowest price
  • Keep the lowest price and review score up to date automatically (daily WP-Cron)
  • Eight domestic booking services: Rakuten Travel, Jalan, Yahoo! Travel, Ikyu.com, Rurubu Travel, JTB, Kinki Nippon Tourist, Relux
  • Four official hotel sites via a manual URL field: Hilton, Marriott, IHG, Hyatt
  • Card display options: button order, per-hotel button visibility, columns, and which fields to show
  • Optional “Powered by Yadokko” credit link (off by default)
  • Click and impression recording on every plan, plus a basic report (totals and a per-service breakdown)

Premium version

The premium version is distributed through Freemius and adds:

  • Five overseas booking services: Agoda, Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Trip.com
  • Microcopy: a short line of supporting text under each button
  • Button design: shape, style, animation and per-service colour overrides
  • Full click report: date chart, per-article and per-hotel breakdowns, estimated revenue (EPC), and CSV export

The plugin hosted here contains only the free version. No premium code is bundled.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services.

Rakuten Web Service (Rakuten Travel APIs)

Used to search for hotels and to periodically refresh the lowest price and review score of hotels you have registered.

  • Data sent: your search keyword or a Rakuten hotel number, the Rakuten application ID and access key you entered, and your site URL (as the Referer / Origin header).
  • When: when you search for a hotel in wp-admin, and once a day via WP-Cron to refresh prices and review scores. No personal or visitor data is sent.
  • Terms of service: https://webservice.rakuten.co.jp/guide/rule
  • Privacy policy: https://privacy.rakuten.co.jp/

Wikimedia Commons API

Used to look up candidate hotel images by keyword. This is optional and only runs when you click the button.

  • Data sent: the search keyword you type (for example a hotel name). The request is made directly from your browser in wp-admin to commons.wikimedia.org.
  • When: only when you click “Search Wikimedia for an image” on the hotel edit or hotel register screen.
  • Terms of use: https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use
  • Privacy policy: https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Privacy_policy

Freemius

Used for distribution, license management and an optional usage-statistics opt-in. The Freemius SDK is bundled with the plugin.

  • Data sent: only if you accept the opt-in screen: your site URL, the administrator email address, and environment information such as the WordPress and PHP versions. Nothing is sent if you skip the opt-in.
  • When: when you choose “Allow & Continue” on the opt-in screen shown on activation, and afterwards for license and update checks.
  • Terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open the “Yadokko” menu in wp-admin and register your hotels.
  3. In “Settings”, enter your Rakuten application ID / access key and your affiliate IDs.
  4. Paste [yadokko id="THE_HOTEL_POST_ID"] into a post or page.
sections.faq:
What do I need for Rakuten Travel search?

A Rakuten Web Service application ID (and access key). Enter them in Settings, on the “Service integration” tab.

Are clicks recorded in the free version?

Yes. Click and impression recording works on every plan, and the free version shows a basic report (totals and a per-service breakdown). The date chart, per-article breakdown, estimated revenue and CSV export are part of the premium version.

Do the booking buttons work without affiliate IDs?

Yes. If you leave the affiliate fields blank, the buttons link directly to each booking site. Enter your IDs to have the links wrapped automatically.

Does the plugin add anything to the front end of my site?

Only the card where you place the shortcode. The “Powered by Yadokko” credit link is off by default and can be enabled in Settings.

Does the plugin track my visitors?

It records anonymous click and impression counts for your own cards, in your site’s own database, so you can see which hotels and articles perform best. Nothing is sent to any external service, and no IP addresses or other personal data are stored. Logged-in administrators are excluded from the counts.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
  • Reworked the free click report: it now shows real totals and a per-service breakdown (previously a sample preview only).
  • The “Powered by Yadokko” credit link is now optional and off by default. Turn it on under Settings then Display.
  • Internal restructure: premium-only features are kept in a separate build. No change to how the free or premium version behaves.

Versions 1.0.0 to 1.0.3 were distributed outside the WordPress.org directory.
